title: Immunobiology – Facilities
html:
Facilities

Immunology Laboratory has outstanding research equipment for studying cellular and molecular processes involved in immunological mechanisms:

Cell culture facilities: sterile cell cultures facilities; complete unit cell culture facilities BSLII and storage facilities in -1960C liquid nitrogen, deep freezers -800C, Nikon 200 microscopes, automatic cell counter Countess (Promega)

Proteomics: VarioSkan Microplate Multimode Detector; Protein microarray and cell array system (Innoscan 1100), NGS chromatographic system (BioRad), standard complete ELISA lines

Cellular physiology: xCELLigence, BD FACSCanto™ II Flow cytometer, BD FACSDiva™6 Becton Dickinson); Cell sorter MoFlo Astrios EQ (Beckman Coulter)

Genomic analysis: ArrayIT Microarray Scanner; Real-time PCR Rotor-Gene (Corbett)

Molecular genetics facility: RT-PCR (Corbett), NanoDrop;

Animal models equipments: CatWalk™XT System.
